response_texts: This is bad... Brace for impact!
Before Anem rebirthed me, I was once a Snow Elf girl.
My father and mother were storytellers serving Jephre, and they often told me fairytales when I was still a child.
I, too, am a storyteller of sorts. And so, I invite you to listen to the hidden song of Jephre, to enter Falmereth, lost in fairytales.
Romion, what are you looking for?
Ozwald, do you remember where my gold-rimmed glasses are? Specifically, a monocle I bought in Cheydinhal.
The monocle of Julianos? Is it not on the airship?
I can't find it anywhere. Oh, where could it be...
The airship was attacked by a large bird a while ago. Could it have fallen off then?
Oh, right... the ship shook quite a lot at that time. We also lost some shipments then. This could be it, yes.
Is it really such a problem that it's gone? Relics like that have a will of their own and tend to vanish on their owners when the time and place is right.
That's true, but it was still a pretty good buy. I can't just give up like this...
Look at the bright side, Professor... At least the airship didn't crash. Be positive, positive!
Yes. Oh, well... I hope that the new owner cherishes the gift.
O tainted soul. Did you hear the secret, hidden in the rain? She is the spinner, only familiar with the knots in the thread.
Even so, she is also your redeemer. So turn back. For we are nothing but dreaming lice. Partake in Kyne's Feast of Love!
What in Oblivion do you intend to do with that heart stone from Ebonwall?
Oh, this heart stone contains the souls and grudges of the people of Ebonwall. It will break the barrier and even rattle the witch, yes?
...This is all too convenient. What would you have done without that heart stone?
This one prepared to have it. What an excellent harvest Ja'zel got simply by letting the Thalmor know about the Ebonwall!
Did you... did you orchestrate the massacre in Ebonwall?! Have you any idea how many uninvolved people died there?
What are you talking about, hmm? Ozwald? The less involved, the better, is it not so?
Enough. Talking to you is just depressing...
Mar-dro knew he could not go back home... He knew this all along. But he simply did not want to give up...
Khajiit is not afraid of dying. He is terrified that his family will die out there if he does not come back home...
The witch's name is Hela and she has pledged her soul to Hircine. And yet, she still calls herself a follower of Kyne. Curious, no?
Hircine... So, what Daedra were summoned, along with their followers? They're much more troublesome than Reachmen and Orc warriors.
Atronachs of stone and plant. We have also identified several creatures kin to Karstaag.
All the cockatrice outside were hunted down, but there is still one inside the barrier, also.
In any case, no tricks will work on an opponent like this. There is no choice but to push through with brute force, yes?
They seem to be relying too much on luck, and just focusing on stalling us.
The Oneiromancer must have already foreseen all our movements, no? Also, they are preparing to summon the avatar of Hircine.
...If they summon Hircine, we don't stand a chance. We'll be the ones getting hunted down, then.
We will simply have to get this battle over with before that happens, yes? Khajiit is counting on you.
It's full of iron daggers and none of them look any good. It seems that moron got a haul of trash again.
The Ashlanders' Wise Woman, Tabiah. She's a Glenmoril witch, considered to be the cause of these riots. She's the target of your mission.
Why is a Glenmoril witch serving as an Ashlander Wise Woman? Tell us more about her.
She was born in Mournhold in the Third Era and served as a lady of Almalexia when she came of age. When the Tribunal fell, she traveled all over Morrowind.
It was around that time that she got in touch with the Glenmoril witches, but I don't know if she still has ties to the other witches.
Since she is suspected to be a Glenmoril witch, we will hunt her down, as usual.
After him! The Chick Trader will find out about our betrayal if he escapes.
Ah, at long last... We are finally here. But there is yet one more step.
So, is the Red Drop here?
No, not here. They were taken from the temple a long time ago.
...If you knew that, then why in Oblivion did you have us attack the temple?
Because the name of the thief and his family is inscribed here, yes?
The witch Hela guarded that secret here, and the Oneiromancer hid the path leading to it!
But why would they be protecting the thief instead of taking back what was stolen?
Ah, because this treasure walks around in a different form, no? And its secrets will now be exposed to the light.
It will take this one some time to decipher the inscription. Soon, we are going to be free of all this. You would like this, no? Ozwald?
You annoy me more with every moment...
O tainted soul. Can you not hear the sound of the pipe? The blue bird is no longer blue. There is nothing to look for in this land.
It is naught but a waste of time. So turn back. We are all nothing but empty lice. You should partake in Kyne's Feast of Love.
Is that some kind of scripture or something? What's wrong with you all of a sudden? Stop that... You're creeping me out.
How did the negotiations with your acquaintance in High Rock go?
It went well. As soon as we have the Red Drop, we'll head to Alcaire in High Rock. We'll take the safest route to the island of Artaeum from there.
Artaeum? Is your friend a member of the Psijic Order?
I used to be one of the Psijics, too, though I had to leave due to lack of talent. But I can still rely on my former colleagues.
They'll be able to hide us if we bring them the Red Drop, and they're better equipped to find the cure.
That's right. I'm sure Cedric and the others will understand if we can just find the cure.
But are you sure about this? You'll be betraying the Chick Trader... We can't be sure what he and the rest will do to us.
It was the Chick Trader who betrayed us first. I will not hesitate about this.
Well then, FL-4N. Let's start.
You can count on me. I'm good at this! Snap!
All right, I'll go ahead. See you soon.
Excuse me, I got lost... Where is the exit?
Aaaaaa, uuuuuu, awwwwwwwww, ooooowon.
What did you say?
Aaaaaa, uuuuuu, awwwwwwwww? Ooooowon?
If you can give me a flower? No need, it's hard to find a cute automaton.
Uuuuuu, eeeewo, nhohoooon.
Oh? This flower can prevent rusting? It's fine, I recently had a rust preventative applied to me.
Ooooooa, eeeeeaw, awwwwwwwwww, nhu, oeeeeeeeaw.
Oh, is that so? That must have been hard. That's the difficult part of being an automaton.
Uwwww, awwwwww, eeeewwwwwwe, awww, uuuuu, ewwww.
Oh, the exit is over there? Thank you very much. Good luck with your work here!
Uwww, aaaaw, uwooon!
You not eat this?
No... I won't eat it...
Is meat.
Meat... No, no, no. I want to help this raccoon.
Really?
Yep, really! Be quiet, Grolly!
Sorry, sorry.
All right. It's okay.
Sniff... Mom, dad... come back...
Come on, I'm trying to sleep. Stop making such noise.
Who are you? How long have you been here?
I've been here long before you arrived. I'm Orlando, a kind mage from Atmora.
I was a great mage back in my homeland, even thought to be an incarnation of Jhunal. Are you familiar with this tale?
If you're so good with magic, why aren't you outside fighting the Snow Elves? All the adults are fighting, aren't they?
I'm afraid I don't know any battle magic. This is why I'm hiding here.
So what kind of magic can you do?
Dream magic. Any dream can be fulfilled with this kind of magic. That's right... What's your dream? I can make it come true.
Really? I want to be a dragon, and fly in the sky on those big wings!
Good, good. So... childlike. I like it.
Now, put on this mask. That way, you will be in tune with your dreams.
Just put on this mask? Is that really all?
Oh, that's all. From now on, no one will recognize you anymore.
What is that supposed to mean? This is getting scary...
Oh, pitiful Night of Tears. For only Ysgramor and his two sons survived it...
What are you talking about? I don't know anything about this! Please, tell me!
You never even mattered. Farewell.
O tainted soul. Can you not see that the cat is lying? False lifes, false words, it is all an act.
So turn back. For we are all nothing but dreaming lice. Partake in Kyne's Feast of Love!
